blind.description: A wooden clothing stand or dress form displaying a ceremonial green cloak or robe. The stand features a circular wooden base, a central pole, a horizontal shoulder bar with rounded knobs, and a decorative spherical finial on top. Draped over it is a green robe with a pale cream or yellow shoulder capelet, gold-trimmed edges along the hem and capelet, and a pleated pale-yellow central opening strip. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and styled in a clean hand-painted aesthetic.
blind.from_above: Shows the top of the pale-yellow capelet draped over the wooden crossbar, centered on a spherical wooden finial, surrounded by the undulating scalloped folds of the green robe below.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 feet tall (roughly 75-80% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide at the widest fold.

notes: 1 separate piece(s) standing on the floor (7%)
